Criterion: Verify that failure of the engine power take-off (PTO) coupling assembly or driveshaft does not adversely affect safe operation of the air vehicle. Standard: The design of the PTO/driveshaft coupling assembly prevents that assembly from unacceptably damaging surrounding hardware (e.g., anti-flail design). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis and inspection of the PTO drawings and hardware ensures a failed coupling cannot unacceptably damage surrounding hardware and air vehicle. Testing verifies driveshaft coupling assembly life and anti-flail capability. References: JSSG-2007: A.3.1.1.10, A.4.1.1.10 Power Take-Off; and A.3.7.16, A.4.7.16 Gearbox
